pages.text: Your race is chosen once at character creation and $(bold)cannot be changed.$() Races modify secondary stats only — they do not touch your HP% or your damage%. That layer belongs to classes.$(br2)The interaction between race and class is where build identity comes from. The same class played by two different races has a meaningfully different feel.

pages.title: The Eleven Races (1/2)
pages.text: $(li)$(bold)Human$() — Versatile. Fastest leveling.$(li)$(bold)Elf$() — Fast, fragile, night-adapted.$(li)$(bold)Dwarf$() — Slow, hardy, fire-resistant, mining mastery.$(li)$(bold)Orc$() — High attack speed, high hunger drain, brutal knockback.$(li)$(bold)Halfling$() — Lucky. Efficient. Small hitbox.$(li)$(bold)Faefolk$() — Nature-attuned. Iron weakness. Slow fall.

pages.title: The Eleven Races (2/2)
pages.text: $(li)$(bold)Revenant$() — Undead. Sunlight weakness. Night power.$(li)$(bold)Demi-God$() — +40% HP, raw-meat healing, strength & phase abilities. Mild Nether weakness.$(li)$(bold)Ryu$() — Draconic. 25% damage reduction, slow fall, clears debuffs.$(li)$(bold)Fallen Angel$() — +15% all damage, slow fall, dash. Fragile (−20% HP).$(li)$(bold)Kirin$() — Fast; wall-climb, sprint-jump, night vision. Fragile (−20% HP).
